code:
# SQL injection has a real fix: parameterized queries.
# It works because SQL has a bounded, formal grammar --
# the engine can enforce "this is a value, not a command."
#
# Natural language has no bounded grammar.
# The same intent can be paraphrased, translated,
# encoded, split across turns, or asked as a hypothetical.
# There is no finite list of "the bad phrases."
caption: You aren't filtering a grammar here -- you're trying to filter meaning.
